aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.0d55: When enabled and Cherished Worlds is installed, automatic backups cover only favourite worlds.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.3f57: Allow backup commands without cheats or operator rights. On a server, this allows every player to trigger them.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.b531: Send backup messages to every player. Disable to notify only players with permission level 2 or higher.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.20e4:
This pack requires FULL_BACKUPS; partial modes are rejected.
- FULL_BACKUPS - creates a complete snapshot of the world files
- MODIFIED_SINCE_LAST - unavailable with the verified backup adapter
- MODIFIED_SINCE_FULL - unavailable with the verified backup adapter
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.3a8a:
Minutes of active server ticks between completed backups; time is saved across sessions. Pausing stops the counter.
5 = every 5 active minutes
60 = every active hour
1440 = every 24 active hours
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.b49e:
ZIP compression level:
  0  = no compression; lower CPU use, larger archives
  9  = strongest compression; higher CPU use, smaller archives
  -1 = library default; this pack starts at 1 for faster background compression
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.0c28:
Shared soft budget for managed completed archives across all worlds. The newest complete copy of every world is protected, even when oversized; staging and unrelated or legacy files are additional.
Format: <number><space><storage type>. The limit is applied after successful publication.
Units: B, KB, MB, GB, TB (powers of 1024; 2 GB means 2 GiB).
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.ccc1:
Unused: managed archives share one output folder and retain separate world identities.
The count remains per world; the soft size budget is shared across all managed worlds.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.55d1:
Always enabled by this pack: the timer counts active server ticks, never time while the game is closed.
At low server tick rates, the real-time gap grows; FPS does not control the counter.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.069c:
Exclusions can make a world snapshot incomplete. Check changes before using them.
Paths are relative to the world root. Defaults exclude no world data.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.759c:
World directories to exclude, including their descendants.
Use paths relative to the world, such as 'logs' or 'data/cache'.
Every file beneath a listed directory is excluded.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.6d83:
Individual world-relative file paths to exclude.
Use complete world-relative paths, such as 'level.dat_old' or 'stats/player.json'.
Use this list for files; use the directory list for whole folders.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.87c1:
Regular expression matched against each entire world-relative path.
Matching paths are excluded; the separator is always /.
Example: '.*\.temp$' excludes files whose names end in .temp.
Leave empty to disable regular-expression exclusions.
horseman.configuration.fix_horse_moved_w: Fix horse jitter and position resets when riding up blocks and stairs (MC-100830).
horseman.configuration.horse_step_height: Extra step height in blocks: 0.1 adds to the normal 1-block step; 1 allows 2-block steps. Zero keeps the normal height.
horseman.configuration.horse_fast_step_d: Add downward velocity when stepping off one block to reduce the slowdown.
Extend faster step-down to 2-block descents. This also affects steep stairs.
horseman.configuration.increase_horse_ai: Reduce horizontal slowdown while jumping or moving off an edge.
Airborne speed between normal behavior (0) and full ground speed (1). A short initial slowdown after leaving an edge remains.
horseman.configuration.horse_swim_when_r: Swim upward while holding jump on a ridden horse. The horseman:cannot_swim entity tag excludes camels and undead horses by default.
horseman.configuration.rotate_horse_inst: Turn the horse toward the player's view when mounting.
horseman.configuration.saddled_horse_wan: Maximum wandering distance in blocks from the last dismount position for saddled horses. Use -1 for normal unrestricted wandering.
horseman.configuration.ridden_horse_prev: Prevent a ridden horse from stopping and rearing.
horseman.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Enable the feature described by this section.
horseman.configuration.requires_lead.too: Require an equipped lead for hitching. Disabling this also removes the special lead slot.
horseman.configuration.lead_slot.tooltip: Add a lead slot to the horse inventory. Without the slot, equip a lead by crouching and using it on the horse.
horseman.configuration.copper_horn_enabl: Enable crafting and use of the Copper Horn for recalling a bound, living animal.
horseman.configuration.copper_horn_sound: Audible range of the Copper Horn in blocks; this does not limit recall distance.
horseman.configuration.copper_horn_coold: Cooldown in ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second. −1 uses the instrument's native duration (140 ticks/7 seconds for the normal goat-horn instruments).
horseman.configuration.copper_horn_error: Show binding and recall failures above the hotbar.
horseman.configuration.max_summoning_dis: Maximum recall distance in blocks. −1 allows any distance. Dimension access is configured separately.
horseman.configuration.max_walking_dista: A loaded horse closer than this distance in the same dimension walks to you; otherwise it is recalled to your position. Zero always recalls it directly.
horseman.configuration.walk_movement_spe: Pathfinding speed multiplier when a recalled horse walks to the player; this is not blocks per second.
horseman.configuration.dimension_handlin: ANY permits recall across all dimensions; SAME requires the same dimension. WHITELIST permits only listed player dimensions; BLACKLIST excludes those dimensions.
horseman.configuration.dimensions.toolti: Dimension IDs used by WHITELIST or BLACKLIST, for example minecraft:overworld. The list is ignored by ANY and SAME.
horseman.configuration.angle_threshold.t: Horizontal view-angle difference in degrees before a stationary horse follows the player's turn.
horseman.configuration.allow_taming_hors: Allow taming attempts without emptying the active hand.
horseman.configuration.mounted_block_bre: Add this fraction of base mining speed while riding horse-type mounts. 5 adds 500% before Minecraft's airborne penalty; 0 adds nothing.
horseman.configuration.horse_fits_in_boa: Allow horse-type animals to fit in boats.
horseman.configuration.shears_remove_che: Use shears on a donkey, mule or llama to remove its chest and drop its contents.
horseman.configuration.horse_creative_ta: In creative mode, using a saddle instantly tames a horse-type animal.
horseman.configuration.leaves_collision_: FULL keeps normal leaf collisions. IGNORE_LOWEST_BLOCK removes collision with the lowest layer; IGNORE_ALL removes all leaf collisions while riding.
horseman.configuration.leash_knot_sounds: Play sounds when a leash knot is untied or broken.
horseman.configuration.dismount_towards_: Prefer a dismount position in the direction the player is looking.
horseman.configuration.fix_running_back_: Stop a previously leashed horse from running back immediately after dismounting.
horseman.configuration.leather_horse_arm: A horse wearing leather horse armor can walk on powder snow like a player wearing leather boots.
horseman.configuration.horse_stats_toolt: Show horse health, estimated jump height and base speed when looking at a horse with suitable food in either hand.
horseman.configuration.improved_mount_gu: Show hunger, experience and experience level while mounted; show jump charge only while jumping. Leave My Bars Alone provides this pack's mounted HUD.
horseman.configuration.fix_mounted_camer: Fix the horizontal camera delay while mounted (MC-259512).
horseman.configuration.prevent_jumping_i: Keep the horse jump meter from charging while the mount is in water.
horseman.configuration.horse_model_head_: Extra downward head pitch in hundredths of a radian, capped at 1.5 radians total. 20 adds 0.2 radians (about 11.5 degrees), not 20 degrees.
horseman.configuration.horse_model_y_off: Lower the horse's head in first person by this many model units.
horseman.configuration.render_lead_indic: Show whether a lead is equipped when hitching requires a lead but the special slot is disabled.
horseman.configuration.player_button_pos: Horizontal offset of the mount-inventory button in the player inventory, in pixels.
Vertical offset of the mount-inventory button in the player inventory, in pixels.
horseman.configuration.horse_button_posi: Horizontal offset of the player-inventory button in the mount inventory, in pixels.
Vertical offset of the player-inventory button in the mount inventory, in pixels.
horseman.configuration.max_opacity.toolt: Remaining opacity at the end angle: 0 is invisible and 1 is fully opaque.
horseman.configuration.start_angle.toolt: Downward view angle in degrees at which the mount begins fading.
horseman.configuration.end_angle.tooltip: Downward view angle in degrees at which the mount reaches its configured minimum visibility.
horseman.configuration.jei_information.t: Show Copper Horn instructions in the recipe viewer's item information category.
horseman.configuration.jeb_horse.tooltip: Give horse-type animals named exactly jeb_ a changing rainbow color.
horseman.configuration.copper_horn_detai: Include binding and recall controls in the Copper Horn tooltip.
mod_menu.descriptionTranslation.ali: Shows the details behind block drops, creature drops, chest loot and other loot tables in EMI, including supported conditions, modifiers and counts. Existing villager trade pages remain with EMI Trades Reborn.
mod_menu.descriptionTranslation.aci: Shared data transfer, numeric expressions and tooltips for Advanced Loot Info. The library has no separate settings screen.
mod_menu.descriptionTranslation.easyanvi: Anvils retain their input items and display them in the world. This pack keeps normal repair materials, repair costs and prior work penalties, with free renaming and no 40-level ceiling.
mod_menu.descriptionTranslation.easymagi: Enchanting tables retain their contents. A manual reroll costs 1 lapis lazuli and 5 experience points, with normal bookshelf rules and one enchantment clue.
mod_menu.descriptionTranslation.horseman: Horse handling, hitching, mount inventories, controlled swimming and Copper Horn recall. Riding horses retains the mining bonus; boats and ship seats do not receive it.
aeroscapes_reimagine.compass.range_help: Searches start from your server position. Up to 5000 horizontal blocks is free. Extended search first checks the free area, then searches up to 10000 blocks. A result farther than 5000 costs 1 XP level; nearby results, failure and cancellation are free. Extended mode requires 1 level at the start and again when a distant result is found. Creative mode is free. Keep the compass in your inventory until the search finishes.
aeroscapes_reimagine.compass.biome_help: Biomes are sampled at intervals, so small regions may be missed. A biome location can lie over the void; the compass does not guarantee solid ground.
aeroscapes_reimagine.compass.insufficien: You need %s XP level for a distant search result. No experience was charged and no distant result was saved. Select the free 5000-block range to search without experience.
aeroscapes_reimagine.compass.not_found: No matching location was found within this search limit. No experience was charged.
aeroscapes_reimagine.compass.sample_limi: The search reached its sampling limit; some locations may have been missed. No experience was charged.
aeroscapes_reimagine.compass.charged: Distant compass result: spent %s XP level.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.1a3e: Native horizontal sampling budget for each search phase; each position checks sampled heights. Small biomes can still be missed. mod_menu.descriptionTranslation.accurate: Continuous accurate block placement through the existing compatibility bridge; ordinary reach and materials, with fast breaking disabled.
mod_menu.descriptionTranslation.simpleba: Quiet full world backups after each hour of active play, with five copies per world and a shared soft storage budget.
mod_menu.descriptionTranslation.naturesc: Biome search is free within 5000 blocks. Extended search to 10000 needs one available XP level and charges it only for a result beyond 5000.
mod_menu.descriptionTranslation.explorer: Structure search is free within 5000 blocks. Extended search to 10000 needs one available XP level and charges it only for a result beyond 5000.
